name: Examples.CoordinateSelection.total_correct_value_view
old_header:
theorem total_correct_value_view (k : Fin n) :
    Total (selectedValue k.val) ∧ Selects (selectedValue k.val) k
new_header:
theorem total_correct_value_view (k : Fin n) :
    Total (selectedValue (n := n) k.val) ∧ Selects (selectedValue k.val) k
change: The first conjunct now explicitly supplies (n := n) to selectedValue, using the same ambient n bound by k : Fin n.
old_header_elaboration_status: Actual attempt2 failed with unresolved implicit n. No equality of previously elaborated types is claimed.
preserved_domains: All n : Nat and k : Fin n; Total quantifies the same Fin n integer input dimension as Selects. No added hypothesis or binder, no rank/domain weakening.
